# Minecraft Terms

This extension adds Minecraft terminology to [Code Spell Checker](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=streetsidesoftware.code-spell-checker).
The same dictionary is available to the [`cspell`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/cspell) command-line
linter through `@pumpkin-plugins/cspell-dict-minecraft`. It covers Minecraft terms and names, not
PumpkinMC-specific terminology.

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/extensions/minecraft-terms/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

To use the dictionary in VS Code, install Code Spell Checker and this extension. When VS Code
starts, the extension registers its packaged dictionary with Code Spell Checker. In an npm project,
install `@pumpkin-plugins/cspell-dict-minecraft` and import its `cspell-ext.json` in your CSpell
configuration. The [dictionary package's install instructions](../../tools/cspell-dict-minecraft/README.md#install)
include the pnpm command and a YAML example.

The GitHub release includes a VSIX for this extension. To install it, download the `.vsix` file,
then in VS Code select **Extensions: Install from VSIX...** and choose that file.
